exposure: Preterm delivery at first birth (before 37 weeks)
outcome: Intrapartum complications in subsequent term delivery
cohort: Women who had two consecutive deliveries between 2012 and 2020, with the first being a vaginal delivery and the second a term delivery.
finding: A first preterm delivery is an independent risk factor for intrapartum complications, including cesarean section, urgent cesarean section, and assisted vaginal delivery, in a subsequent term delivery.
mod_finding: First preterm delivery was associated with higher rates of cesarean section (including urgent cesarean) and assisted vaginal delivery at the second term delivery.
gest_age: First delivery: before 37 weeks (categorized as <34 weeks and 34+0 to 36+6 weeks); Second delivery: >=37 weeks.
